observations: Photo 0: Black Canon DSLR body with 'Canon' logo; '800D' text visible on the right side of the body; lens attached.
Photo 0: Lens front shows '18-55mm' text (appears to be the kit lens).
Photo 1: Rear view of the camera; screen/controls visible; no clear view of shutter count or internal condition.
Photo 2: Front/side view again; 'EOS 800D' visible; lens attached; no clear view of lens fungus/scratches.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show a Canon DSLR with '800D' on the body and photo 0 shows '18-55mm' on the lens.
No photo/screenshot of shutter count (e.g., camera info screen or shutter count app output).

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Photos do not provide a close, angled inspection of the lens glass for fungus/scratches.
No photo showing the battery/charger labels or included items.
No service history, warranty card, or internal/repair evidence shown.

risks.risk: Shutter count may be higher than claimed (affects value).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from a shutter-count tool or the camera info showing total actuations.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Canon 800D with unknown/high shutter count (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Lens may have hidden fungus/haze or scratches not visible in these angles (affects image quality).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens glass at multiple angles under light (front element, rear element, and edges).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens condition not guaranteed (worst case: treat as needing discount for possible issues).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or non-original battery/charger (affects usability).
risks.proof: Photo of all included items laid out clearly: battery model label, charger model label, and what exactly is included.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories may be incomplete/unknown (worst case: value reduced).

risks.risk: Camera may have faults (AF, buttons, shutter, sensor dust) not shown in photos.
risks.proof: Short video showing autofocus on a moving subject + a sample photo at different apertures, plus a quick test of key buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults (worst case: treat as standard used with potential issues).

proof_requests: Send a shutter count screenshot/photo (total actuations) from a shutter-count tool or camera info.
Send close-up, well-lit photos of the lens front and rear glass (multiple angles) to confirm no fungus/haze/scratches.
Photo of the included battery and charger showing their labels/models, and confirm what accessories are included in the box.
Provide a short test video: autofocus lock on a subject + quick menu/button check, and 2-3 sample images.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Canon EOS 800D with an 18-55mm kit lens, so the item type is identifiable; however key claims (shutter count, lens condition, accessories, repair history) are not provable from the images, so it should be priced at the worst case among the matching comparables.
